description: Check whether a domain is reachable and healthy: DNS, certificate, redirects, security headers. One call on a domain: A, AAAA, NS, MX and SPF records; the TLS certificate with issuer, expiry and days left; the HTTP redirect chain hop by hop; and which security headers are present. Read from our infrastructure. Query: ?domain= — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "check whether this domain is healthy", "is this domain trustworthy", "check dns records and ssl of a domain".
name: domain_health
